root_cause: The dropdown component does not restore focus to the toggle button when the menu is hidden, so after pressing Escape focus remains lost (on the body) instead of returning to the actions-toggle button.
repair_strategy: Add a call to focus the toggle button (`this._element.focus()`) in the `_completeHide` method after setting `aria-expanded` to false, ensuring focus returns to the button whenever the dropdown is hidden.
expected_accessibility_effect: Pressing Escape will close the invoice actions menu and move keyboard focus back to the 'Invoice actions' toggle button, allowing keyboard users to resume interaction without losing focus.
functional_risks: Focus may be moved to the toggle when the menu is hidden via other means (click outside, programmatic hide), which could be unexpected if the user activated a menu item and expected focus to remain where they clicked. However, this matches the ARIA menu button pattern and is unlikely to break core functionality.
verification_requirements: After pressing Escape, the attribute aria-expanded on #actions-toggle must be 'false'.
After pressing Escape, the active element must be #actions-toggle.
ArrowDown should still open the menu and move focus to the first menu item.
Enter/Space on a menu item should trigger its associated action and update the last-action output.
Clicking outside the menu should close it and return focus to the toggle (consistent with the fix).
